title: Organization Design, Incentives, Decision Rights, and Coordination
description:
This video explains the importance of organization design, incentives, decision rights, and coordination in a modern firm. It covers the key concepts, including the difference between formal and real authority, the power of incentives, and the need for decentralization. The video also discusses the importance of evidence-based decision-making and the need for a robust design that generates evidence about its own performance. The video references the work of economists such as Ronald Coase, Friedrich Hayek, and Bengt Holmström, and provides examples from real-world companies such as Wells Fargo and Safelite Glass Corporation.
